items: The present rates can be changed unilaterally by the bank (unless otherwise specified in the agreement).

Accounts are being closed if transactions on the account are not conducted for more than 1 (one) year and in this case, small balances in the account (less than 1 AZN, 1 USD and 1 EURO) are attributed to the income of bank.
Previous rates shall be deemed invalid from the date of entry into force of the present rates.
If payment order made in manat is presented on weekdays (Monday – Friday) till 2 p.m., and received after 2 p.m. on the current day, it is executed on the next business day.
If payment order made in foreign currency is presented on weekdays (Monday – Friday) till 4 p.m., and received after 4 p.m. on the current day, it is executed on the next business day.
Unless otherwise specified, Bank itself chooses the correspondent bank for the execution of customers’ payment documents.
Individual rates can be agreed by contract in cooperation with correspondent banks.
Rates dated 02.03.2011 agreed with International Bank of Azerbaijan remain in force.
The term “monetary unit” (MU) is applied to the currencies such as Azerbaijani manat, USD and Euro.
